Change c0037. Location: 1818 Letter IV; 1831 Letter IV.

Context before (unchanged): This aroused the stranger's attention; and he asked a multitude of questions concerning the route which the dæmon, as he called him, had pursued.

1818 text: Soon after, when he was alone with me, he said, "I have, doubtless, excited your curiosity, as well as that of these good people; but you are too considerate to make inquiries."

1831 text: Soon after, when he was alone with me, he said,—"I have, doubtless, excited your curiosity, as well as that of these good people; but you are too considerate to make enquiries."

Diff: Soon after, when he was alone with me, he said, {+—+} " I have, doubtless, excited your curiosity, as well as that of these good people; but you are too considerate to make [-inquiries-] {+enquiries+} . "

Context after (unchanged): "Certainly; it would indeed be very impertinent and inhuman in me to trouble you with any inquisitiveness of mine."

result.rationale: Change is orthographic: 'inquiries' becomes 'enquiries' with no change in meaning. The only other edit is an added dash after 'he said,', which is punctuation, not wording.
